component.name: Wirecraft
component.summary: Visual development framework with explicit data links

description.p: Wirecraft is a development framework for scaffolding software visually. Break a solution into processing components and declare the typed links through which they exchange data, so the architecture reads like an assembly line instead of a hidden call graph. Write each component's algorithm under its generated function header, with language-server support, and generate C17, Rust, Go, Kotlin, JavaScript or PHP programs.
Links are optional: without them, composites act as folders and entities as files that keep code, specification and test data together. Wirecraft opens Threadworks-compatible .orch projects.
